name: conduit
description: Conduit, the RealWorld app, in Lean: a REST API and a browser app compiled to WebAssembly by Lasm, with proofs

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:workers: npm run build:client && lasm build ServerWorkers.lean --target workers --output dist/server
scripts.build:bun: npm run build:client && bunx --bun lasm build ServerBun.lean --target bun --output dist/server
scripts.build:deno: npm run build:client && lasm build ServerNode.lean --target deno --output dist/server
scripts.build:deno-deploy: npm run build:client && lasm build ServerEdge.lean --target deno-deploy --output dist/edge
scripts.build:vercel-edge: npm run build:client && lasm build ServerEdge.lean --target vercel-edge --output dist/edge
scripts.build:netlify-edge: npm run build:client && lasm build ServerNetlifyEdge.lean --target netlify-edge --output dist/edge
scripts.build:supabase-edge: npm run build:client && lasm build ServerSupabase.lean --target supabase-edge --output dist/edge
scripts.build:fastly: npm run build:client && lasm build ServerFastly.lean --target fastly --output dist/wasm
scripts.build:wasi-http: npm run build:client && lasm build ServerWasiHttp.lean --target wasi-http --output dist/wasm
scripts.build:docker: npm run build && docker build -t conduit .
scripts.build:lambda: npm run build && lasm package dist/server --target lambda
scripts.build:lambda-image: npm run build && docker build -f deploy/lambda-image/Dockerfile -t conduit-lambda:local .
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build && lasm package dist/server --target vercel
scripts.build:netlify: npm run build && lasm package dist/server --target netlify
scripts.build:azure: npm run build && node deploy/package-hosted.mjs azure
scripts.build:gcf: npm run build && node deploy/package-hosted.mjs gcf
